name: Muha Meds x Cookies Disposable | Gary Payton
description: Step into the zone with Gary Payton — a powerhouse indica known for its bold, earthy flavor and deeply relaxing effects. Dank and hazy with a hint of spice, this strain hits smooth and finishes strong. Ideal for unwinding and finding your calm, Gary Payton brings balance to the body and mind while keeping your head clear and steady.
